claimFunds(uint256).notice: Creator collects the ETH of a successfully funded project (once).

claimRefund(uint256).notice: Contributors recover their money from a Failed project.

createProject(string,string,uint256,uint.notice: Launch a campaign. Goal is in wei, deadline is a unix timestamp.

finalizeProject(uint256).notice: Anyone can call this after the deadline. It marks the project Failed         only if it is still Active AND below its goal, so each project is counted once.

fundProject(uint256).notice: Contribute ETH. Never lets `raised` exceed `goal`; excess is refunded.

withdrawContribution(uint256).notice: A contributor takes back their full contribution while the campaign is active.
